facts.text: Caroline received a necklace with a cross and a heart from her grandmother in Sweden, which symbolizes love, faith, and strength.

evidence.quote: This necklace is super special to me - a gift from my grandma in my home country, Sweden. She gave it to me when I was young, and it stands for love, faith and strength.

facts.text: Caroline possesses a hand-painted bowl that was created by a friend for her 18th birthday ten years prior, and it represents art and self-expression.

evidence.quote: I've got some other stuff with sentimental value, like my hand-painted bowl. A friend made it for my 18th birthday ten years ago. The pattern and colors are awesome-- it reminds me of art and self-expression.

facts.text: Melanie recently went camping in the mountains with her family, which she described as a nice time together.

evidence.quote: I just took my fam camping in the mountains last week - it was a really nice time together!
